title: Alert on oracle nixos-upgrade failure
intent: Send the same Telegram alert for oracle's failed nixos-upgrade as for paphos', from paphos' existing hourly oracle check, without putting the bot token on oracle
proof_hooks: oracle authorized key renders restrict+forced systemctl is-failed with paphos host key
paphos known_hosts pins oracle host key; secrets.nix eval unchanged
generated relay script passes bash -n and shellcheck
deployed: probe returns unit state; arbitrary commands refused; forced-failure test alert observed; state restored
stop_conditions: oracle upgrade failure produces a Telegram alert
